title.ja: 四間飛車vs棒銀①　居玉棒銀・練習問題
title.en: Fourth-file Rook versus uncastled Climbing Silver: practice

intro.ja: 「四間飛車vs棒銀①　居玉棒銀」で学んだ形を、実際に手順を指して確認します。
intro.en: Play through the moves to check what you learned in “Fourth-file Rook versus uncastled Climbing Silver”.

courses.title: 四間飛車vs棒銀①　居玉棒銀・練習問題: 居玉棒銀への6五歩
courses.titleEn: Fourth-file Rook versus uncastled Climbing Silver practice: P-6e against uncastled Climbing Silver

branches.note: 学習用の基本手順。角道を開ける。
branches.noteEn: Teaching sequence; adapt to different replies. Open the bishop diagonal.
Transfer the rook to the sixth file.

branches.note: 角頭を守る駒を7七へ置く。
branches.noteEn: Place a defender on 7g to cover the bishop-head area.
Develop White’s left silver toward the center.

branches.note: 角道を閉じ、角交換を避ける。
branches.noteEn: Close the diagonal to avoid an immediate bishop exchange.

branches.note: 左銀を上げ、角の後方を支える。
branches.noteEn: Develop the left silver behind the bishop.

branches.note: 銀を7三へ進め、棒銀を準備する。
branches.noteEn: Develop the silver to 7c for Climbing Silver.
Begin moving Black’s king toward the right wing.

branches.note: 銀を8四へ進め、角頭を狙う。
branches.noteEn: Advance the silver to 8d toward the bishop head.

branches.note: 7筋から歩をぶつける準備をする。
branches.noteEn: Prepare a pawn clash on the seventh file.

branches.note: 角道を開け、前進した銀への反撃を作る。
branches.noteEn: Open the bishop diagonal for counterplay against the advanced silver.

branches.note: 角を5五へ出し、8二の飛車を狙う。
branches.noteEn: Develop the bishop to 5e, attacking the rook on 8b.
